subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**preceding.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In context of blank 2 we need a word that explains the changes that happened in the past centuries.
 
• Now, let us understand the given words:
 
 
• **"Preceding" means existing or happening before someone or something**.
 
 
• Example: The chart on the preceding page explains everything.
 
 
 
 
 
• The above word will be accurate in blank 2 as well because it will mention the years that have passed.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
